name: Edge Centres EC8 Traralgon
notes: Edge Centres' second Victorian data centre, in Traralgon (Latrobe City, ~160km east of Melbourne); construction announced and ground broken per trade press; free-cooling design using local climate, ~1MW on-site solar, 48h battery/UPS backup; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: NEXTDC M3 West Footscray
notes: NEXTDC's Melbourne M3 facility at 25-27 Indwe Street, West Footscray (City of Maribyrnong); ~A$229m build approved ~2020, construction began 2021, launched 2022; in Mar 2026 NEXTDC applied to the state Development Facilitation Program (fast-track) to roughly double the centre's size; capacity in MW not published.

name: Perri Projects PMDC West Footscray
notes: Proposed four-storey data centre (~A$1bn) on 2.72ha former woolstore site at 1 McArthur Street / 63 Sunshine Road, West Footscray (City of Maribyrnong); subdivision permit granted by Maribyrnong Council; proposal lodged with Victorian Department of Transport and Planning fast-track (DFP) as of 2023-2025 reporting; capacity not disclosed.

name: NEXTDC M1 Melbourne (Docklands)
notes: NEXTDC's flagship Melbourne facility at 820 Bourke Street / 826 Lorimer Street, Docklands (City of Melbourne LGA); built 2012, acquired from APDC in 2018; Uptime Tier III certified, first Australian DC with 4.5 NABERS rating; 550 MWh/yr rooftop solar array; per-cabinet MW capacity not published in cited sources.

name: Telstra InfraCo Exhibition Street Data Centre
notes: Telstra InfraCo colocation data centre at 155 Exhibition Street, Melbourne CBD (City of Melbourne LGA); one of two Telstra InfraCo Melbourne data centres, interconnected via fibre with its counterpart (Clayton); capacity not disclosed in cited sources.

name: Vocus MEL03 Melbourne CBD
notes: Vocus carrier/data centre at 530 Collins Street, Melbourne CBD (City of Melbourne LGA); Vocus moved into the former ASX building in 2013 with build-out capacity of up to ~400 racks; 5G Networks' 'Melbourne Data Centre' (acquired for A$5.7m) is also hosted at 530 Collins Street; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: AWS data centre Cobblebank (AWS Melbourne Region)
notes: AWS data centre planned on 13.2ha site at 54-80 Ferris Road, Cobblebank (City of Melton, ~40km west of Melbourne CBD); Amazon paid A$60.5m for the site in July 2023; part of A$6.8bn AWS Melbourne Region investment; June 2026 announcement that Greater Western Water's Melton Recycled Water Plant (Mt Cottrell) will supply recycled water to the 'soon-to-be-built' facility from day one; reported value ~A$50m (per Baxtel); MW capacity not disclosed.
